description: A width and height given as percentages resolve against the containing block

florui.css: .wrap { display: flex; flex-direction: row; gap: 12px; width: 240px; padding: 10px; box-sizing: border-box; background-color: #223; } .bar { width: 100px; height: 12px; background-color: #556; } .fill { width: 68%; height: 100%; background-color: #4c8; } .box { width: 100px; height: 80px; background-color: #556; } .half { width: 50%; height: 50%; background-color: #e85; } .border { box-sizing: border-box; width: 50%; height: 100%; border: 4px solid #fff; background-color: #48c; }
